instruction: Set slide page numbers to red by entering View > Master Slide, selecting the slide master, and changing the page number placeholder's text color to red (RGB: high red, low green/blue).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide page number colors to red. Custom getter downloads PPTX file, custom metric validates color via XML parsing of slide master. Added postconfig to save the file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to change page number colors to red
Metric semantically identifies page number placeholders using proper XML targeting: './/p:sp[.//p:nvSpPr//p:ph[@type="sldNum"]]' (line metrics/pptx.py:69)
Text color extraction covers multiple valid locations in PPTX structure: text run properties, paragraph default run properties, list style, and shape style (lines 82-111)
RGB color validation correctly implements the 'high red, low green/blue' requirement using threshold-based comparison (lines 26-28)
Handles all slide masters in the presentation, not just the first one (lines 50-61)
Correct parameter handling: metric uses 'expected.get('color')' directly, understanding that expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
Appropriate postconfig: saves file with Ctrl+S to persist PPTX changes before verification
Robust error handling: returns 0.0 when page number placeholder or color cannot be found, with logging
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add more detailed logging about which slide master contains the page number placeholder if multiple masters exist
Edge case: Could validate that the found color element is actually visible (not overridden by other formatting), though this is a minor enhancement
